“the stakes for our movement has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our movement have never been higher”
“federal goverment” >>> “federal government”
“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”
“three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]
“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”
“central principal” >>> “central principle”
“In brief, the bill:” >>> “In brief:”
“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”
“directly effect every company” >>> “directly affect every company”
“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier.]
“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”
“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The earlier summary gives a $1 million daily civil penalty; confirm the amount and whether the amendment keeps or changes it.]
“who's support” >>> “whose support”
“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”
“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”
“28 members, 13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These categories total 29 members, not 28.]
“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: Only five senators are listed, but the preceding sentence says six are undecided. Also clarify whether Kowalski and Ames, discussed below, belong in this list or in a leaning category.]
“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”
“a seperate interview” >>> “a separate interview”
“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”
“Commerce Commitee” >>> “Commerce Committee”
“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”
“occured” >>> “occurred”
“hearing on the impacts of deep-sea mining occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: The earlier discussion references a September 23 hearing. Confirm whether these were separate hearings or correct the date.]
“treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary says 18 months, not two years. Confirm the deadline and whether it requires concluding negotiations.]
“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”
“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”
“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”
“recieve updated talking points” >>> “receive updated talking points”
“Each of our five field organizers” >>> [CHECK: The paragraph begins with six field organizers, not five.]
